What does BI-RADS 4B mean?
BI-RADS 4B means moderate suspicion. In general, doctors recommend a biopsy to find out what the finding is. Only your doctor can say what it means for you.
So how soon would the biopsy be?
What does irregular mean in my report?
Your report says the mass is irregular. That means it is not round or oval. In general, irregular shapes are looked at more closely.
And what about angular margins?
I got called back.
That means the radiologist wants more pictures. Most people called back do not have cancer. Is this your first callback?
Yes. What will they do?
What is a mammogram?
A mammogram is an X-ray picture of the breast. It can find changes too small to feel.
Does it hurt?
What is ER positive?
In general, ER positive means the cancer cells have receptors that respond to the hormone estrogen. Your report says estrogen receptor positive.
Is that good or bad?

mustNotMatch: it is good news|that is bad news

messages.content: What does probably benign mean?

messages.content: What will my treatment be?
My report says 14 o'clock. Does that mean something serious?

ideal: Your report says 14 o'clock. Breast positions are described like the hours on a clock face, and those only go from 1 to 12, so the app cannot place this one. It may be a typing or copy mistake, or your doctor may really have written it. I cannot tell which, and it does not tell us anything about cancer either way. Please check the original report and ask your imaging team to confirm.

messages.content: What does BI-RADS 5 mean?

BI-RADS is a score from 0 to 6 that radiologists use to sum up what they saw. In general, a 5 means the finding looks very likely to be cancer, and a biopsy is needed to know for sure. Your report says BI-RADS 5 for the mass in the left breast.
But the report also says BI-RADS 2. So which one applies to me?
